## Proposal or update

Describe the proposal's purpose or what changed. Link the RFC file and related issues.

## Review context

Name the questions needing feedback and any prior decisions this changes.

- [ ] The status distinguishes a draft, an accepted design, and a landed implementation.
- [ ] Any acceptance or implementation claim links its evidence.
- [ ] Metadata, related RFC references, and the generated index are current.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/rfcs.py check` passes.

Merging a document does not itself accept the feature.
